Job Description
 We have an opportunity for an Advanced System Engineer to join us at Honeywell Technologies, in Bucharest, where you will lead highly complex technical activities, from requirements analysis and technical solution validation through detailed engineering, configuration, integration, testing (FAT/SAT), commissioning, customer handover, and post-implementation support.
The job holder shall be able to perform maintenance and configuration tasks required for DCS and Safety Systems, including related OT technologies (Cisco Networking Systems, Virtual Systems based on vMware or Nutanix technologies, Active Directory (AD), install control system’s software patches and Microsoft updates.
Position is to perform DCS and Safety Systems Migrations and Upgrades and Software and Hardware troubleshooting.
 Honeywell Technologies
 We have been innovating for more than 100 years and now we’re creating what’s next. Our programs serve a global community and our hometowns too. We provide resources and financial support to causes around the world and encourage employee volunteerism. We are committed to the highest standard in everything we do!
 Responsibilities
 Key Responsibilities
 Responsible for technical scope of assigned projects 
 Participate in Kick Off Meetings, internal FATs, FATs, SATs, Commissioning and start-up. 
 Server/Station Configuration/Administration in Physical or Virtual environment; 
 Effectively communicates with customers to fully define and agree project requirements. 
 The responsibility includes the coordination of teams of engineers on projects. 
 Ensures that required prerequisites (e.g. design inputs, tools, documentation, deliverables, schedule and budget) are in place prior to commencing work. 
 Installation of the control system’s software and hardware Patches, Upgrades and Migrations. 
 Perform cyber security activities with technical support from cyber security experts. 
 Networking Configuration (Switches, Routers, Firewalls) 
 The scope of the projects might also include 3rd party integration, SCADA, PLC programming and migrations 
 The engineer makes sure the scope and schedule are monitored and met. 
 Reports progress and technical problems and / or changes to project lead engineer or Project Manager. 
 Can technically coach / mentor and actively share knowledge with less experienced engineers in the project team. 
 Shares technical knowledge with project team, supervisor, own discipline and other engineering disciplines. 
 Proactively recommends potential quality and efficiency improvements within the engineering group. 
 Comply with Corporate, local, Health, Safety and Environmental regulations. 
 Performing daily activities related to the areas of responsibility, according to the performance level established and regularly monitored by internal management tools (eg Tier / Weekly / Monthly) 
 Achieving the performance objectives set by the manager through the HPD system 
 Acts in accordance with Honeywell behaviors 
 Flexibility is required 
 Creates System Architectures and IP Lists 
 Creates the FAT, SAT procedures and Operator manuals. 
 Creates the Detailed Design Specifications (DDS). 
 Creates the Functional Design Specifications (FDS). 
 Will require carrying out site work and international assignments at a yearly average of 50% 
 Qualifications
 Key skills and qualifications
 Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Automation, Telecommunications and Information Technology, Electrical, Electronics). 
 >10 years previous relevant experience 
 Good knowledge of Cisco Networks (CCNA, CCNP) and Virtualization (VMware, Nutanix) 
 Good knowledge and experience in hardware assembly process. 
 Knowledge on English language is must. (Technical and commun. level). 
 Knowledge of Honeywell HPS Systems hardware platforms Experion, Safety Manager, SM SC. 
 Good knowledge in Microsoft Server, Windows applications and AD management 
 Cyber Security awareness (McAfee, Symantec) 
 Back-up software (Acronis) 
 Good knowledge of ISO requirements. 
 Good knowledge of HSE Requirements. 
 Organizing skills. 
 Good interpersonal and communication skills. 
 Team player 
 Judgment, Problem Solving 
 Customer intimacy 
 Continuous improvement drive 
 Results Orientation 
 Driving license (B)

 About Us
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.
